name: Red alert
description: When an alarm goes off (smoke, water, intrusion…) Atena slowly flashes all Home Assistant lights red and repeats the urgent message on every Chromecast; when the alarm ends the lights go back as they were.
capabilities: Red flashing house lights (slow, safe for light-sensitive people)
Urgent voice message on every Chromecast, repeated every 25 seconds
Lights automatically restored as they were
Stops by closing the alarm widget or when the alarm clears
